allowed_hosts.description: List of allowed host IPs or CIDR ranges (regex patterns, escaped with ^ and $) that may connect to this node.

port.description: TCP port on which the munin-node daemon listens for incoming connections.

user.description: System user account under which the munin-node daemon runs. For security, consider using a non-root user (e.g., 'munin').

group.description: System group under which the munin-node daemon runs. Typically matches the user group (e.g., 'munin').

dirdir.description: Directory containing plugin configuration snippets (one per file).

logdir.description: Directory where munin-node logs are stored.

rundir.description: Directory for runtime files like PID and socket files.

htmldir.description: Directory for HTML output (used when serving munin stats directly via webserver).

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: 0 = minimal, 1 = normal (recommended), higher = verbose (for debugging).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

timeout.description: Connection timeout in seconds before closing idle connections.

strict_host_verification.description: Whether to strictly match client IP against allowed_hosts (true) or allow relaxed matching (false, legacy behavior).

node_hostname.description: Explicit hostname to report to the munin master. If empty, the FQDN is auto-detected and used.

plugin_conf_includes.description: List of directories to scan for plugin configuration fragments (includedir statements).
